verdict.rationale: Source connections automatically sync data in the background once configured, and webhooks push real-time notifications on sync completion instead of requiring polling, which shows some autonomous background operation. However, this is limited to data ingestion/sync events — there's no evidence of general-purpose scheduled or agent-triggered automation workflows running independently within Airweave itself. Missing for 10: documented scheduling/cron controls, autonomous agentic task execution beyond search/sync, and independent confirmation that background syncs run reliably at scale.
